logline: When ruthless thugs desecrate Juliana's medicinal garden and trample her late mother's herbs, a protective Alexander charges into the night to defend her.
continuity_notes: Follows Episode 14 where Alexander solemnly vowed Juliana would never be hurt again; Juliana's hands remain heavily bandaged from retrieving the emerald ring.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: High-angle wide shot of the raised planter beds illuminated by the pale moonlight as three shadowy figures march purposefully down the central stone path.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Three menacing thugs, armed with clubs and tools, stalk through the quiet herbal garden surrounded by stone walls.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle medium shot focusing on one thug raising a heavy wooden club overhead.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: The thug brutally smashes his club down into a wooden planter box, shattering the frame.

segments.label: SOUND FX
segments.text: A splintering wooden crash echoing through the night air.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of a bald thug leaning over a lush bed of white medicinal chamomile herbs.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: The bald thug roughly rips a massive handful of flowering herbs up by their roots, scattering soil across the path.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot framing the open doorway of the stone cottage, bathed in warm interior light against the dark night.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana bursts through the cottage doorway, her hands wrapped in clean white bandages, freezing in horror at the destruction.

segments.label: JULIANA (Desperate, Alarmed)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Stop! What are you doing?!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of the Thug with Cap holding the uprooted chamomile bouquet, sneering with cruel amusement.

segments.label: THUG WITH CAP (Mocking, Smug)
segments.speaker: THUG WITH CAP
segments.text: We're clearing this rubbish.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Juliana, her face tight with anguish and fury as she clutches her bandaged hands against her chest.

segments.label: JULIANA (Furious, Pleading)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Those are medicinal plants!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle shot tracking down from the bald thug's grinning face to his worn leather boots on the muddy flagstones.

segments.label: BALD THUG (Callous)
segments.speaker: BALD THUG
segments.text: They look like weeds to me.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: The bald thug flings the bouquet into the mud and grinds his heavy boot directly onto the delicate flowers.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: High-angle two-shot as Juliana rushes forward and drops directly onto her knees in the cold mud before the thug.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana frantically tries to scoop the crushed soil and torn stems back into the bed with her bandaged hands.

segments.label: JULIANA (Choked with Tears, Desperate)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Please! Those plants took months to grow!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium two-shot of the Tall Thug with the club and the Thug with Cap bursting into raucous laughter under the full moon.

segments.label: TALL THUG (Contemptuous, Derisive)
segments.speaker: TALL THUG
segments.text: Months? You actually spend your days growing this filth?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tight close-up of Juliana's bandaged hands trembling as she tenderly gathers the soiled white flowers from the puddles.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle medium shot tilting up as Juliana rises from the ground, standing tall despite her trembling frame.

segments.label: JULIANA (Defiant, Firm)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Leave my garden alone.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of the Thug with Cap scoffing derisively.

segments.label: THUG WITH CAP (Sneering, Disdainful)
segments.speaker: THUG WITH CAP
segments.text: A noble lady playing in the dirt. What a joke.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of Juliana, her eyes blazing with indignation and wounded pride.

segments.label: JULIANA (Resolute, Dignified)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: It is my home. You have no right to destroy anything here.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tight close-up of the Thug with Cap stepping aggressively into Juliana's personal space, snarling with venom.

segments.label: THUG WITH CAP (Menacing Snarl)
segments.speaker: THUG WITH CAP
segments.text: Get out of the way!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Extreme close-up on Juliana's piercing blue eyes and set jaw, unflinching.

segments.label: JULIANA (Steely, Fearless)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: No.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: The Thug with Cap violently shoves Juliana back with both hands; she cries out as she loses her balance and crashes hard onto the wet stone path.

segments.label: JULIANA (Gasping Cry)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Ah!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up tracking down to Juliana's hand hitting the mud next to the crushed chamomile flowers.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana crawls forward on her elbows; fresh crimson blood seeps profusely through her white gauze bandages as she reaches for the ruined blossoms.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tight close-up on Juliana's mud-streaked, tear-stained face trembling in heartbreaking agony.

segments.label: JULIANA (Broken, Sobbing)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: My mother's plants...

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle wide shot of the three thugs pointing and laughing hysterically at her kneeling form.

segments.label: BALD THUG (Cruel, Laughing)
segments.speaker: BALD THUG
segments.text: Look at her! Crying over weeds!

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: The Tall Thug hoists his heavy wooden club above his head to crush the remaining herbs right before Juliana.

segments.label: JULIANA (Screaming)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Stop!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of the Thug with Cap suddenly stiffening, his smug smile dropping as footsteps pound in the darkness.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium tracking shot as Alexander charges past the corner of the cottage into the misty moonlight, his dark coat billowing behind him.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Alexander storms forward with lethal intensity, dark hair flying, breath misting in the cold, radiating untamed rage.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana looking up through wet lashes, trembling as shock transforms into overwhelming relief.

segments.label: JULIANA (Whispered Breath, Stunned)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Alexander...

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Wide shot of the three thugs wheeling around to face the dark figure approaching from the mist.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle tracking shot from behind Alexander's broad shoulders as he steadily steps past the fallen Juliana, towering over the intruders.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Alexander places himself directly between Juliana and the three thugs, staring them down with cold, deadly intent.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of the three thugs regrouping, the Thug with Cap feigning swagger as he grips his club.

segments.label: THUG WITH CAP (Challenging, Arrogant)
segments.speaker: THUG WITH CAP
segments.text: What? You want to fight us, veteran?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana looking up with wide, anxious eyes, breath hitching in suspense as violence hangs on a knife's edge.

segments.label: SOUND FX
segments.text: Tense, low dramatic cello swell holding into an abrupt cliffhanger cut.
